scenes.text: Imagine diving thousands of feet deep into the pitch-black ocean and suddenly discovering a massive, surreal lake, complete with its own sandy shoreline, flowing ripples, and active underwater waves.
These mind-blowing underwater lakes are called brine pools, and they form when ancient salt deposits dissolve beneath the seafloor, creating water that is five times heavier and saltier than the sea.

Because these dense pools contain absolutely zero oxygen, any unsuspecting deep-sea fish or crab that accidentally swims inside is instantly pickled, preserving their lifeless bodies perfectly for decades in a toxic graveyard.

This represents one of the most hostile yet fascinating environments on our entire planet, so would you ever dare to explore these depths? Let me know in the comments and follow for more insane mysteries.
